title: FrontmatterGeminiSkill
description: Frontmatter shape for nodes classified as `skill` by the Gemini Provider — Agent Skills delivered as `SKILL.md` files (https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/creating-skills/). Google documents only `name` and `description` as required frontmatter fields; both already live in the spec's universal `frontmatter/base.schema.json`. `additionalProperties: true` so vendor additions flow through unchanged.
